secrets.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Chave que assina os cookies de sessão do Better Auth. Gerada automaticamente (32+ bytes aleatórios); trocá-la desloga todo mundo.

secrets.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Login com GitHub (opcional; precisa também do GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET). Crie um OAuth App em https://github.com/settings/developers → OAuth Apps → New OAuth App, com Authorization callback URL = https://<seu-dominio>/api/auth/callback/github. Copie o Client ID.

secrets.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Client secret do OAuth App do GitHub (mesma tela do GITHUB_CLIENT_ID → Generate a new client secret).

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Login com Google (opcional; precisa também do GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET). No Google Cloud Console (https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials) → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Web application, com Authorized redirect URI = https://<seu-dominio>/api/auth/callback/google (configure antes a OAuth consent screen). Copie o Client ID.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Client secret do OAuth client do Google (mesma tela do GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID).
